lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Bao Estrada is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Bao Estrada is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Bao kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Bao's gone." Pearl looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Bao." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Wanda blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Research & Records (Level 1). Find information fast: indexes, archives, and asking the right question.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.

d41: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Bao's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Bao Estrada, 41 days. The mantle passes to Wanda Long.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Wanda Long, 27 — a librarian. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Berserker Rage.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Bao — and Bao is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Giovanni, Pearl, Olga and 6 more speak for Wanda — "Bao trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Wanda before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
